value.quote: We carry out large-scale empirical analyses for the U.S. House
value.note: The main results are empirical analyses of real data (EM). Section 4 and Appendix B simulate synthetic rankings (SI). Partisan map optimisation is strategic districting (SB), and proportionality is the evaluation objective (WD). Proposition 1 and the dynamic and integer programs give efficient computation of outcomes and optimal maps (AL).

C1.reason: Both the strategic gerrymandering optimisation (SB) and the efficient-computation results such as Proposition 1 (AL) are main results, so the union of both coders' types applies.
